scope.description: Whole premiere application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Media ingest, timeline editing, audio, effects/colour, titles/captions, rendering/export and collaborative project workflows.

coverage.rationale: Timeline inspection is a very narrow portion of an editor and does not author, render or export a movie.

scope.description: Read-only source identity and named multi-track frame-layout/coverage contracts.

abstraction.rationale: Named coverage requirements and exact layout decisions hide native tick/asynchrony handling, but users must build the project and declare detailed expected clips.

limitations: Native qualification remains pending; host-tested contracts are not a demonstrated Premiere run. No native editing/export, audio, captions, effects, source-byte or rendered-content checks.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
